hero.headline: Contemporary embroidery. Better-proportioned shirts.
hero.body: Everyday shirts shaped by Indian textile language, clean shoulders, and embroidery engineered into the cloth.
hero.image_alt: A NABZ Self-Contour shirt being constructed on a model

positioning.body: India’s textile language, re-cut into everyday shirts. Restrained from a distance. Unforgettable up close.
positioning.linear_alt: Linear couching embroidery on dark cloth
positioning.counted_alt: Dense counted stitching in copper and rose thread

fit.headline: Choose the width you need. Then choose the length.
fit.body: Most shirts grow wider and longer together. NABZ separates the two. Choose S, M, or L for the room your body needs. Choose Standard or Extended where available.
fit.unavailable: Extended length is available in M and L
fit.guidance: Up to 5′8″? Start with Standard. Above 5′8″? Start with Extended. Height is guidance, not a rule.

air.headline: Designed from the shoulder down.
air.body: A clean shoulder line changes the whole shirt. Ours is built with a stable yoke, a controlled armhole, and room through the upper body—without a dropped seam or padded silhouette.
air.proof_2: Embroidery that belongs to the fabric.
air.name: Air Cable
air.editorial_alt: Model wearing the ivory Air Cable shirt
air.shoulder_alt: Air Cable shoulder construction and tonal embroidery
air.cord_alt: Raised tonal cord embroidery on cotton-linen cloth

drop.headline: Two shirts. One clear point of view.
drop.logo_alt: NABZ embroidered wordmark on dark brown cloth

product.headline: The details that change the whole silhouette.
product.shoulder_body: A stable yoke and controlled armhole create structure without padding or a dropped seam.
product.length_body: Choose the room your body needs, then choose Standard or Extended length where available.
product.embroidery_body: Stitch direction, density, and texture are designed with the cloth—not placed on top as an afterthought.

footer.headline: Stay close to the stitch.
footer.body: New shirts, material notes, and the next NABZ drop. No noise.
